title: Prove the compiled MCP server through the real MCP SDK
summary: The full verification profile is the release gate and must prove that the optional MCP dependency is usable, but after the compiled-plugin migration it only proved that the mcp module is importable: the sentinel that instantiated a real server was removed with tests/test_transport.py. This change adds tests/test_compiled_mcp_smoke.py, which drives create_compiled_mcp_server through the real FastMCP SDK, asserts the SDK lists the compiled lifecycle tools, and invokes the read-only list_plugins tool through the SDK call path. run_tests.py excludes it from the dependency-light fast profile and includes it in the full profile.

platform: The platform owns the compiled MCP server and its release-gate coverage

forbiddenResponsibilities: The smoke test must exercise the real MCP SDK, not a stub or a monkeypatched server
The change must not weaken the full profile's no-skip rule
The change must not add a new CI job or change the CI matrix
acceptance: tests/test_compiled_mcp_smoke.py fails when the real MCP SDK server cannot be created or invoked
run_tests.py full runs the smoke test and stays green with no skips
run_tests.py fast stays dependency-light and does not run the smoke test
no new workflow job or matrix entry is added

humanApproval.decision: Internal-only release-gate coverage restored under the mandate in #assayer-group:4c84ee19; the gap and its scope were confirmed with @assayer_rev on 2026-09-17.
